facts.claim: Generated main.js:100 constructs the single native renderer with antialias:!IS_TOUCH. setupQuality:159-187 never changes this context attribute. Low removes composer/shadows but desktop direct scene rendering still targets an MSAA default framebuffer. Actual desktop reports confirm antialias=true even at low/.35.

High uses HalfFloat WebGLRenderTarget(samples:4); mid requests samples:0; low bypasses composer. Three 0.169.0 allocates render-target multisampling using renderTarget.samples and capabilities.maxSamples, independently of the default framebuffer antialias constructor option. High requests four samples subject to device support.

RenderPass directs scene geometry into the composer read buffer; OutputPass draws a fullscreen quad to the default framebuffer. Therefore setting only constructor antialias:false preserves the existing high-quality offscreen 4-sample scene pipeline. Do not alter HalfFloat, bloom, RenderPass, OutputPass or quality selection.

Same-build local production-AA=true first observed race is 30.3178s; existing no-MSAA diagnostic reaches race in 18.029s, a 12.2888s difference. The changed context option is isolated by the diagnostic script, same desktop viewport and full scene. This is substantial evidence for default-framebuffer MSAA cost but only one sequential local pair; it is not a CI guarantee or a universal speedup estimate.

CI desktop reaches low/.35 at +23.6162s; another 21.0983s only advances cdT .3133 to 1.5217. Emergency jump timing improved yet the full low renderer remains too slow in this run. cdT is capped simulation time, not a direct measured FPS counter.

At .35, desktop drawing buffer is 478x268=128104 pixels; touch is 295x136=40120 pixels, desktop about 3.193 times as many. The sibling touch pass alone cannot separate MSAA from pixel load; the same-desktop no-MSAA comparison is more specific.

CI low/no-HUD phase reports 595 draws and 445938 triangles; restored low reports 627 draws and 471233 triangles. Same-context empty rendering averages 25.62ms while restored full scene averages 488.37ms. This supports substantial scene-dependent work, not a diagnosed permanently poisoned context.

Counters and sequential phases cannot partition JavaScript submission, vertex processing, fragment shaders, MSAA sample/resolve bandwidth, driver overhead, or warmup. No-HUD also changes quality over time, so the original versus no-HUD means do not isolate DOM cost. Composer original calls=1/triangles=1 describes a final fullscreen render due auto-reset, not the entire scene. Context probe does not record pixel ratio.

Static Batch already groups by material, 260-unit tile and shadow flag. buildGround defaults to 320x320 subdivisions and main supplies no seg override, so it creates a 204800-triangle terrain mesh. Smaller framebuffer size does not reduce submitted geometry or draw count. Geometry/batching is a separate possible follow-up, not necessary scope for the first MSAA patch.

Three renderer constructor defaults alpha=false but internally requests WebGL alpha=true. The context diagnostic new renderer explicitly passing alpha:false matches the old constructor default; it does not establish an alpha-attribute causal difference. Its recorded attributes/info are still read from the original renderer.
